retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait featuring a massive, expressive script title that overlaps the subject's hair and forehead.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with textured hair, set against a neutral grey background. A large, fluid, black script word dominates the upper half of the composition, partially obscuring the subject's hair, while a secondary blocky serif font spans the very top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Large script title overlaps the subject's forehead and hair
Monochrome subject contrasts with a flat mid-grey background
Vertical white sidebar (obi strip) provides a secondary information plane
Tight cropping focuses on the face and shoulders
coreInvariants: Fluid, continuous-stroke script for the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered head-and-shoulders portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, which are positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold script at the top, down to the subject's eyes, then to the vertical sidebar on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Mid-grey background provides breathing room around the head and shoulders.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for hair, shadows, and typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the vertical sidebar and highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between skin highlights and deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script and heavy slab serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title: Thick-to-thin brush strokes, continuous fluid motion, large loops on 'S' and 'l'.
Secondary title: Ultra-bold slab serif with high horizontal compression.
Sidebar: Clean, sans-serif and vertical Japanese characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the script is oversized and acts as a framing device for the left side of the head.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, organic script paired with a rigid, geometric slab serif for maximum formal contrast.
graphicDevices: Vertical informational strip (obi) on the left edge

candidateDirections.reason: To mimic the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the main title.
To approximate the heavy slab serif at the top.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with 80s-style textured hair against a flat grey background, leaving space at the top for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, black, hand-written style script title across the upper third, overlapping the hair, and a secondary bold slab-serif title at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the script title large enough to overlap the hair?
Is the vertical sidebar present on the left?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure script does not obscure the eyes
Verify the vertical sidebar is clean and white
Confirm the slab serif at the top is horizontally compressed
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Large Script Overlay + Vertical Info Strip
